title: Varints and tagged fields
hints: Encode by repeatedly writing the low 7 bits with the "more" bit, then shifting right by 7. Decode by collecting 7 bits from each byte until one has the top bit clear, giving up after 10 bytes.
In the decoder, read tag and length, check the length fits in what is left, take that many bytes as the value, and only then decide what the tag means. Skipping an unknown tag is then automatic.
